metadata.description: The Canary E-cad plugin marketplace for EPLAN Electric P8 and EEC Pro: agent skills for scripting, the EPLAN API and Remote Client, plus the documentation RAG MCP servers.

plugins.name: eplan
plugins.description: Everything: the router plus all EPLAN skills (Electric P8 scripting, API and Remote Client; EEC Pro typicals, formulas and generation) and the three documentation RAG MCP servers.

plugins.name: eplan-scripting
plugins.description: EPLAN Electric P8 only: C# scripting, the EPLAN API (parts database, 3D), Remote Client automation, verified action parameters and production pitfalls. Covers EPLAN 2022-2027.

plugins.name: eec-pro
plugins.description: EPLAN EEC Pro 2026 only: typicals and the mechatronic model, the formula language, configuration interfaces, scripting, and generation into P8 / Pro Panel / PLC / text targets.
